home.title: Nét Nút Studio | Website redesign for growing businesses
home.description: Nét Nút clarifies the message, restructures information, and redesigns websites so they reflect the business as it is today.

about.title: About Nét Nút Studio | Website redesign
about.description: Nét Nút helps businesses clarify what already works, remove website friction, and build a direction that fits the present.

contact.title: Start a conversation | Nét Nút Studio
contact.description: Share the context of your current website to start a clearer redesign conversation.

hero.title: Old site. Rebuild it properly.
hero.body: Your current website no longer keeps pace with the business. Nét Nút clarifies the message, restructures the information flow, and designs an experience that reflects the brand’s real position.

services.title: What we do
services.lede: Rebuild the parts that keep a website from keeping up with the business.

items.title: Website redesign
items.copy: Keep the brand equity that still works, remove outdated structure, and rebuild the experience so the site matches the company.

items.title: Business websites
items.copy: Build from information architecture through interface and performance so content is clear, services are findable, and the brand feels trustworthy.

items.title: Campaign landing pages
items.copy: Each landing page focuses on one message and one primary action, so visitors move straight to the next step.

items.title: Motion and interaction
items.copy: Motion is designed to guide attention, clarify feedback, and keep pacing — not as decoration alone.

work.title: How we diagnose
work.ariaCompare: Compare the old website and redesign with arrow keys
work.hint: An illustration of how structure and hierarchy change before and after.
work.captionBody: Diagnose the inherited structure, keep what still has value, then rebuild a clearer path.
work.visualNewSub: A website that keeps pace with the business.

blocks.title: Start from the website you have.
blocks.copy: Nét Nút reviews the current site, decides what to keep, what to change, and aligns on one core design direction before a full build.

blocks.title: Stay lean and go straight to the work.
blocks.copy: Mark creates presence. Action creates progress. Nét Nút is a Vietnam-based studio focused on business website redesign — direct collaboration, clear scope, and fast decisions.

finalCta.title: See how a website gets rebuilt.
finalCta.body: The Nhà Mộc case study shows diagnosis, design decisions, and before/after versions in one comparison frame.
finalCta.note: The case study does not represent a client project. What matters is the diagnosis and the reasoning behind each design decision.

hero.title: About Nét Nút
hero.body: Businesses change over time. Websites need to change too — to reflect real value, scale, and how the company operates today.

dictionary.netDef: is how a brand is seen and felt — layout, language, imagery, color, rhythm, and the character that shapes how it appears to customers.
dictionary.nutDef: is what takes people from seeing to acting — how they find information, understand the offer, build trust, and reach a decision.
dictionary.close: For us, a good website does not choose between beauty and effectiveness. It needs both.

manifesto.eyebrow: The current website is the starting point
manifesto.lede: Share the site and current context. Nét Nút works with you to identify what is worth keeping, what is in the way, and what needs clarity before moving on.
lines: Remove what gets in the way.

vision.eyebrow: What Nét Nút does in that gap?
vision.lede: Nét Nút does not start with a new formula. It starts by reading the website and business you already have, then reordering the path so it fits today.

tracks.label: Read
tracks.copy: Look at the current website with the business context — what has accumulated, and what no longer serves the present.

tracks.label: Order
tracks.copy: Clarify structure, message, and the primary path so visitors find what they need without guessing.

tracks.label: Build
tracks.copy: Set a direction and scope that fit. Design, code, and motion appear only when they help the site work better.

culture.title: A small studio. Direct work.
culture.body: Nét Nút is a small studio in Vietnam that works directly with each business. The people who understand the problem, propose the direction, and build the product stay close throughout. Less information is lost, decisions move faster, and ownership stays clear.

outro.srTitle: Have a website that needs rebuilding?
outro.lead: A good website does not choose between beauty and effectiveness. It needs both.
outro.display: Have a website that needs rebuilding?
outro.close: If the site no longer reflects the business, start with today’s context. Nét Nút will help identify what needs clarity before proposing the next step.

intro.lede: Share what the website needs to solve.

points.title: Full website redesign
points.copy: When the current site no longer keeps pace with scale, services, or how the business operates.

points.title: Restructure message and architecture
points.copy: When the clearest need is path, content, or information hierarchy on the current site.

points.title: Not sure where to start
points.copy: That’s fine. Share the current context, what still feels stuck, and what you want the website to do better.
